text:
ana: FYI — I pushed a proposal for runtime and routing metrics PR: new labels + dashboards. Need quick alignment on cardinality before we ship. cc @chris @sasha

chris: Link?

ana: https://rwd.internal/pulse/PR-4321 — short summary: add route, model_variant, customer_tier, region labels. Also add `quota_bucket` for quota hits.

devin: Main concern: customer_tier + route could blow up cardinality if route includes full path params. We should normalize route -> route_name.

sasha: agreed. propose label `http_route` with sanitized values like `/generate`, `/embeddings` not full ids. Also we need `model_family` not model full name.

marco: what about broken-out dimensions we use in console? console wants route + model for per-route cost view.

liz: console needs per-customer charts for quota alerts; we can rely on customer_id low-card if we sample. Maybe use `customer_id_hash` and only include for alerting traces.

chris: OTel has `service.name`, `http.route` standard attr. let's align: map `http.route` -> `http_route`, `model.family` -> `model_family`.

ana: OK. two action items: 1) update PR to use `http_route` sanitized; 2) add docs with cardinality limits and recommended label values. Also add a fallback `route_bucket` for high-card routes. + can we add a prom relabel rule example.

devin: I can add relabel config snippet. sample:
```
- source_labels: [__path__]
  regex: '/v1/generate.*'
  target_label: 'http_route'
  replacement: '/generate'
```

sasha: also add note: don't attach `customer_id` to high-frequency metrics; use a trace/span with attribute instead.

infra-bot: Reminder: prometheus scrape configs updated on prod-staging. See #eng-infra for rollout schedule.

chris: One more: quotas. `quota_bucket` should be low-card (e.g., 'user', 'workspace', 'org'). Not raw numeric ids.

marco: Can we add `model_size_class` (small/medium/large) to help cost dashboards? Low-card, yes.

liz: SGTM — will update dashboard templates to accept `model_family`, `model_size_class`, `http_route`.

ana: Great. I'll update PR, add relabel examples and a short cardinality table. Plan: merge Thursday EOD if no blockers. If someone wants to pair review ping me.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: metrics-schema/4321 to staging at 18:30 UTC.

chris: :thumbsup:
